core_rule: Worker selection is recommendation-only. If Phase 4 decision is blocked, needs_clarification, or unverified_gate, Phase 5 must return selection_blocked.

selector_decisions.recommendation_ready: A recommendation-only worker/lane/provider candidate can be named for later review.
selector_decisions.selection_blocked: Permission, risk, target, authority, dirty-tree, or gate state blocks selection.
selector_decisions.needs_clarification: More target, task, acceptance, lane, or permission detail is needed before selecting.
selector_decisions.no_suitable_worker: No known worker/provider/lane satisfies the requested capability and authority constraints.
selector_decisions.unverified_capability: Required route, provider, worker, or lane capability was not checked or is unavailable.

fail_closed_rules: blocked, needs_clarification, or unverified_gate from Phase 4 blocks worker selection
provider/model candidates are recommendation-only unless a later phase approves calls
local worker/model candidates are recommendation-only unless a later phase approves starts/calls
no worker/provider can grant approval, apply, commit, push, or self-approve
handoff preview packets are data-only and cannot dispatch
dirty-tree conflict, protected lane overlap, or broad file zone blocks selection
fake-green risk must be carried into Phase 6 verifier needs
capability mismatch returns no_suitable_worker, not a forced selection
